newsitem.title: THAILAND: RESEARCH ALERT-Buy Advanced Info, Shinawatra.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Buy Advanced Info, Shinawatra.

text.p: Asia Equity reiterated on Tuesday its buy recommendation on Advanced Info Services Plc on the basis of its undemanding ratings as well as the company's strong long-term competitive advantage.
Asia Equity also said as a result it has a buy recommendation on Shinawatra Communication Plc, which holds the majority stake in Advanced Info, a mobile phone operator.
"We recommend investors buy SHIN as it is capitalised at less than the value of its holding in (Advanced Info)," Asia Equity said in a report.

Asia Equity said Advanced Info's earnings of 3.56 billion baht ($137 million) in 1996 were in line with expectations. Asia Equity forecasts the company will show a profit in 1997 of 3.77 billion baht.
"However, we believe our forecasts are conservative," the report said.
At 0756 GMT, Advanced Info was up two baht to 238, while Shinawatra was off one baht at 199. ($1 = 26 baht)
